Derryth Bonecloak is a gold dwarf and trader in Ebonlake Grotto.
“
Look at that. Got my useless old man back.
„
— Derryth Bonecloak when her husband is returned safely

Involvement

Act One

Derryth waits impatiently near the western entrance of the Myconid Colony for her husband,  Baelen, to return from picking mushrooms. When the party speak to her for the first time, she asks if they have seen her husband. If not, the party can ask about Baelen, which reveals — alongside her low opinion of him — that she sent Baelen on an errand he is yet to return from. She welcomes the party to find him, but refuses to pay a ransom if he is found and returned.

If Baelen is rescued, Derryth rewards the party with the  Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo. She begrudgingly thanks the party and explains that she and her husband arrived in the Underdark to collect  Noblestalk, a mushroom with incredible restorative abilities. She needs it to save their shop in Baldur's Gate because Baelen had nearly bankrupted the store to purchase alcohol. If the party mention they found a Noblestalk, Derryth asks for the mushroom but offers nothing in return. If the party give Derryth the Noblestalk, she thanks them and encourages them to visit her at Bonecloak's Apothecary when they reach The Gate.

Alternatively, the party can withhold the mushroom from Derryth, asking her to beg. Selecting and passing one of the following options results in Derryth offering her wedding ring, a  Tarnished Ring:

  • [INTIMIDATION] Not good enough. Give me something, or I'll toss you into a chasm. (DC 10)
  • [ROGUE] [PERSUASION] Not good enough. Give me something, or this noblestalk disappears right before your eyes. (DC 10 )
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] Correct. PAY UP. NOW. (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] I know exactly what you owe. Pay up. (DC 10 )

Act Three

If Baelen was rescued in the Underdark, he and Derryth can be found at Bonecloak's Apothecary in the Lower City.

If Baelen was not rescued, then Derryth manages the store alone, melancholic of her late husband and lamenting that they both deserved better. She believes Baelen's soul found its way to The  City of Judgement, wasting away unclaimed as a faithless. The party can encourage one of three cats near the store —  Barsik,  Malta, or  Myshka — to join Derryth in her shop so that she is less lonely.

If Derryth obtained a Noblestalk in the Underdark, then she sells 2-3 Noblestalks in her shop, which is refreshed after every long rest. Unlike the Noblestalk found in the Underdark, the ones in her store cannot restore lost memories for  Shadowheart or the Dark Urge.

Otherwise, if Baelen was rescued and the party used the Noblestalk to heal him, he manages the store alone and has no Noblestalk to sell. Derryth can be found in the Elfsong Tavern, where she thanks the party for healing Baelen because it caused her to finally leave him forever. She comments that she does not have much to her name now but the freedom and peace of mind are worth it.

Speak with Dead

Derryth Bonecloak can be spoken to with  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Derryth Bonecloak
      Derryth... Bonecloak...
  • Where are you from?
    • Derryth Bonecloak
      Baldur's Gate... shop there... Bonecloak's...
  • What is your profession?
    • Derryth Bonecloak
      Alchemist...
  • What happened to you?
    • Derryth Bonecloak
      Don't know. Pain... then darkness...
  • Where are your valuables?
    • Derryth Bonecloak
      No valuables... only my ring...
  • What were you doing here?
    • Derryth Bonecloak
      Noblestalk...
  • Did you come here alone?
    • Derryth Bonecloak
      No... husband. Baelen...
  • Where is Baelen? (If the party did not meet Baelen)
    • Derryth Bonecloak
      Gone... noblestalk...
  • Why is Baelen so confused? (If the party met Baelen)
    • Derryth Bonecloak
      Mind's slipping... made him less of a bastard...
  • Baelen's in danger. How do I help? (If the party know of Baelen but he is not yet rescued)
    • Derryth Bonecloak
      Don't know... don't care...



Notes

  • After obtaining the  Noblestalk, Derryth mentions she will be on her way and informs her husband that they are leaving. Despite this, they do not actually leave Ebonlake Grotto during Act 1.
  • Derryth has always had a secret desire for an unseen character named Glumbor.
  • In previous updates, it was possible to give the Noblestalk to Derryth, pickpocket it back, and then use it for another NPC (Baelen, Thulla, Shadowheart, etc), while still retaining the later gains of the Noblestalk that Derryth could supply in Act 3. This is no longer possible without the use of mods or cheats. Derryth will still hand off the quest reward for giving her the Noblestalk, but upon arrival at her store, she will be in dire straits, and there will be a dialogue option to give Derryth the Noblestalk, if the party still possess it. Upon doing so, Derryth will then sell the additional three (3) Noblestalk as if the party had never pickpocketed it from her.
